crossRefs.note: Please let’s make a little room on the roof. Let’s set a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp stand for him there. When he…
She went up and laid him on the man of God’s bed, and shut the door on him, and went out.
When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and lying on his bed.
In those days, she became sick, and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

translations.web: He said to her, “Give me your son.” He took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the room where he stayed, and laid him on his own bed.
translations.bsb: But Elijah said to her, “Give me your son.” So he took him from her arms, carried him to the upper room where he was staying, and laid him on his own bed.
translations.kjv: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.
translations.asv: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the chamber, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.
